content: However, Table TABREF19 shows that these scores can still be improved by averaging or ensembling the individual models. On the dev set, averaging our 8 individual models results in a better score for 8 out of 10 subtasks, while creating an ensemble beats all of the individual models as well as the average for each subtask. On the test set, however, only a small increase in score (if any) is found for stepwise ensembling, compared to averaging. Even though the results do not get worse, we cannot conclude that stepwise ensembling is a better method than simply averaging.
